sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines 
the equipment inspection
I1, to be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

This pump transfers the condensate from the hot 
well of condenser to the condensate pre-heaters then to the deaerator then to 
the feed tank.
المواصفات الفنية:

The first draft is 
initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Mamdouh Ghazy, reviewed by 
eng. Ahmed Fathy, revised by inspection and quality control at EDEPC the 
coordinator of MPIS documents eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, accepted by general 
manager eng. Mohamed Farg Anan, and approved by eng. Mohamed Elsarrag: head 
sector of Damietta PS3x135MW.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and

 prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the CB of 
 the pump motor.

Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves.

Be sure pump must 
 be completely
 drained.
